about.title: About Sparfuchs Berlin
about.intro: Sparfuchs Berlin compares the big supermarkets' weekly offers and Aldi Nord's everyday prices. An offer is only matched to a product when it really is that product, and everything is compared per kilo, litre or piece.
about.dataSourcesText: Offers come from rewe.de, penny.de, aldi-nord.de and kaufland.de, everyday prices from aldi-nord.de's online range. Everything is fetched daily at 05:00; expired offers disappear automatically. REWE, Penny and Kaufland only publish their weekly offers online, so everyday prices are from Aldi Nord only for now.
about.disclaimerText: All prices without guarantee. Actual in-store prices may differ. This is not an official service of the stores named.
